title: Astro Portal session event payload: auto_time_confirmed
description: The observer confirms the time the device's clock counted on one target in automatic advance mode. The journal is append-only, so a confirmation cannot be a field set later on the target_started/target_finished events it confirms: it is this event, naming the target the same way they do. It confirms every event of that target carrying `auto: true` that comes before it in session order; an auto event written after it (the target resumed and moved on by itself again) is unconfirmed until a later confirmation. Naming a target that has no auto event changes nothing. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

targetId.description: The same catalogue id the target's target_started/target_finished events used.

targetLabel.description: The same free label the target's target_started/target_finished events used, for a target with no catalogue id.

planItemId.description: Optional: the plan item this target came from, when the session was started from a plan (planner-document.schema.json's plan.items[].id).
